en.title: New York City Council Holds Rare Sworn Hearing on Advanced AI Risks
en.excerpt: Executives from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and Meta testified under oath as the city weighs local AI regulation.
en.content:
On Monday (US time, Nov 5), the New York City Council convened a rare Council Committee of the Whole hearing on the potential risks of advanced AI models. **Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and Meta** each sent senior executives to testify under oath about model safety and proposed legislation.

Anthropic sent frontier red-team lead Logan Graham; OpenAI was represented by policy and operations head Morgan Dwyer; Google sent AI policy director Alice Friend; and Meta sent legislative AI policy director Shane Cahill. Three of the four agreed to appear only after the council threatened subpoenas, while a subpoena was also issued to SpaceX over SpaceXAI. The hearing follows a summer of disclosed model incidents and researcher warnings about catastrophic-risk models.

zh.title: 纽约市议会就前沿 AI 风险举行罕见宣誓听证会
zh.excerpt: Anthropic、OpenAI、谷歌与 Meta 高管宣誓作证，纽约市正推进地方性 AI 监管立法。
zh.content:
美东时间 11 月 5 日，纽约市议会在罕见的「全体委员会」形式下，就先进 AI 模型的潜在风险举行听证会。**Anthropic、OpenAI、谷歌与 Meta** 均派出高管宣誓作证，说明模型安全并回应拟议立法。

Anthropic 派出前沿红队负责人 Logan Graham，OpenAI 由政策与运营主管 Morgan Dwyer 代表，谷歌派出 AI 政策总监 Alice Friend，Meta 则由立法政策总监 Shane Cahill 出席。除 Meta 上月主动确认外，其余三家均在市议会以传票相威胁后才同意出庭；纽约同时已向马斯克的 SpaceX 发出强制传票。听证会导火索是今夏以来多起模型失控事件与内部爆料，市议会正推进含举报人激励、受害者起诉权与第三方独立审核的地方性 AI 监管立法。

en.title: Apple Reportedly Pays Google About $1 Billion a Year for Gemini to Power Siri
en.excerpt: A multi-year deal would make Google's Gemini the cloud reasoning layer behind rebuilt Siri, Bloomberg reports.
en.content:
Apple is finalizing a multi-year agreement to license **Google's Gemini** as the cloud reasoning engine for a rebuilt Siri, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. The deal is valued at roughly **$1 billion per year**.

Unlike the earlier optional ChatGPT integration, Gemini would become the embedded foundation of Apple Intelligence, handling summarization, planning and complex multi-step tasks, while Apple's own on-device model covers personal data. Apple is developing a roughly 1-trillion-parameter in-house model as a future replacement, but its own frontier model is not yet ready.

zh.title: 苹果据报每年向谷歌支付约 10 亿美元，用 Gemini 驱动新版 Siri
zh.excerpt: 彭博报道，一份多年协议拟让谷歌 Gemini 成为重建版 Siri 的云端推理层。
zh.content:
据彭博社 Mark Gurman 报道，苹果正敲定一份多年协议，以**谷歌 Gemini** 作为重建版 Siri 的云端推理引擎，协议价值约**每年 10 亿美元**。

与此前可选的 ChatGPT 接入不同，Gemini 将成为 Apple Intelligence 的内置基础层，负责摘要、规划与复杂多步任务，而苹果自研端侧模型继续处理个人数据。苹果正在开发约 1 万亿参数的自研云端模型作为未来替代，但其自有前沿模型尚不成熟。

en.title: Anthropic Projects Up to $70 Billion Revenue by 2028
en.excerpt: Internal projections put API sales at $3.8 billion this year, roughly double OpenAI's comparable figure.
en.content:
Anthropic has internally projected revenue of as much as **$70 billion** and $17 billion in cash flow by 2028, according to TechCrunch and The Information. The company expects about **$3.8 billion** from API sales this year, nearly double the roughly $1.8 billion OpenAI is projected to earn from similar services.

The forecast reflects an enterprise-first strategy: Anthropic targets $20-26 billion in annual recurring revenue for 2026 and serves more than 300,000 corporate customers. Gross margin is expected to swing from negative 94% last year to 50% this year and 77% by 2028.

zh.title: Anthropic 预计 2028 年营收最高达 700 亿美元
zh.excerpt: 内部预测显示今年 API 销售额约 38 亿美元，约为 OpenAI 同类收入的两倍。
zh.content:
据 TechCrunch 与 The Information 报道，Anthropic 内部预计 2028 年营收最高可达 **700 亿美元**、现金流 170 亿美元；今年 API 销售额约 **38 亿美元**，接近 OpenAI 同类服务预计 18 亿美元的两倍。

该预测体现其「企业优先」策略：Anthropic 目标 2026 年实现 200 亿至 260 亿美元年度经常性收入，服务超过 30 万企业客户。毛利率预计由去年的负 94% 升至今年的 50%，并在 2028 年达到 77%。

en.title: Web Inventor Tim Berners-Lee Warns AI Could Collapse the Ad-Supported Internet
en.excerpt: Generative AI answering queries directly could unravel the advertising model behind Google and Meta.
en.content:
Tim Berners-Lee warned at a London event that the advertising model underpinning hundreds of billions of dollars of internet value could **fall apart** as generative AI rises. If LLMs browse the web and answer users directly, the ad-driven web loses its audience.

The warning targets the core business model of giants like Google and Meta, whose valuations rest on massive ad networks. Berners-Lee argued the shift could reshape how the open web is funded.

zh.title: 万维网之父伯纳斯-李警告：AI 或令广告驱动的网络经济崩塌
zh.excerpt: 生成式 AI 直接给出答案，可能瓦解支撑谷歌与 Meta 的广告商业模式。
zh.content:
蒂姆·伯纳斯-李在伦敦一场会议上警告，支撑互联网数千亿美元价值的广告模式，可能因**生成式 AI 的崛起而分崩离析**。若大语言模型直接浏览网页并替用户作答，依赖广告的网络生态将失去受众。

这一警告直指谷歌、Meta 等巨头的核心商业模式——其万亿市值正建立在庞大的广告网络之上。伯纳斯-李认为，这种转变可能重构开放网络的变现逻辑。

en.title: NVIDIA Joins India's Deep-Tech Alliance as Founding Member
en.excerpt: The India Deep Tech Alliance, a coalition of PE and VC firms, has pledged $2 billion to the sector.
en.content:
NVIDIA has joined the **India Deep Tech Alliance (IDTA)** as a founding member, according to media reports on Nov 5. IDTA is a coalition of private-equity and venture-capital firms that has pledged **$2 billion** to deep-tech investment.

The move deepens NVIDIA's footprint in one of the fastest-growing AI markets and aligns with India's push to build domestic AI compute and startup ecosystems.

zh.title: 英伟达以创始成员身份加入印度深度科技联盟
zh.excerpt: 由私募与风投机构组成的印度深度科技联盟已承诺向该领域投资 20 亿美元。
zh.content:
据 11 月 5 日媒体报道，英伟达已以**创始成员**身份加入「印度深度科技联盟（IDTA）」。该联盟由私募股权与风险投资机构组成，已承诺向深度科技领域投资 **20 亿美元**。

此举深化了英伟达这一全球增长最快 AI 市场之一的布局，也契合印度发展本土 AI 算力与初创生态的战略。

en.title: OpenAI Revives Its Robotics Team, Hires Former Meta AR Hardware Lead
en.excerpt: Caitlin Kalinowski joins to lead robotics and consumer hardware, four years after the team was disbanded.
en.content:
OpenAI is restarting the robotics team it disbanded about four years ago, hiring **Caitlin Kalinowski**, the former head of Meta's AR glasses project, to lead robotics and consumer hardware. Kalinowski led Meta's Orion AR prototype and spent nearly nine years running VR hardware teams.

OpenAI confirmed the move to TechCrunch. Kalinowski will initially focus on robotics partnerships to integrate multimodal AI into physical hardware, re-entering a field where OpenAI has so far only invested in partners like Figure and 1X.

zh.title: OpenAI 重启机器人团队，挖来 Meta 前 AR 硬件负责人
zh.excerpt: 在团队解散约四年后，OpenAI 聘请前 Meta AR 眼镜项目负责人 Caitlin Kalinowski 统领机器人与消费硬件。
zh.content:
在约四年前解散硬件研究团队后，OpenAI 正重启机器人团队，并聘请**前 Meta AR 眼镜项目负责人 Caitlin Kalinowski** 领导机器人与消费硬件业务。Kalinowski 曾主导 Meta 的 Orion AR 原型，并有近九年领导 VR 硬件团队的经验。

OpenAI 已向 TechCrunch 确认该消息。她将先期聚焦机器人合作，把多模态 AI 集成进物理硬件——这也是 OpenAI 在曾投资 Figure、1X 等伙伴之后，重新亲自下场具身智能的信号。

en.title: Meta Fined 21.6 Billion Won by South Korea Over Privacy Violations
en.excerpt: The Korean PIPC penalized Meta for breaching the Personal Information Protection Act.
en.content:
South Korea's Personal Information Protection Commission fined **Meta about 21.6 billion won** (roughly 112 million yuan) for violating the country's Personal Information Protection Act, per a decision at its 18th plenary meeting on Nov 4.

The penalty underscores tightening enforcement of data-protection law against global platforms and serves as a warning on lawful collection, processing and storage of user data.

zh.title: Meta 因违反韩国《个人信息保护法》被罚约 216 亿韩元
zh.excerpt: 韩国个人信息保护委员会认定 Meta 违反《个人信息保护法》，作出处罚决定。
zh.content:
在 11 月 4 日召开的第 18 次全体会议上，韩国个人信息保护委员会决定对美国互联网公司 **Meta 处以约 216 亿韩元（约合 1.12 亿元人民币）** 行政罚款，理由是违反韩国《个人信息保护法》。

此次罚款意味着对全球平台数据保护执法的收紧，也为企业在收集、处理与存储个人数据时必须合规敲响警钟。

en.title: NVIDIA Shows Next-Gen Co-Packaged Optics Prototype at SEMICON West
en.excerpt: The OOI design puts the optical engine directly on the GPU interposer to cut interconnect distance.
en.content:
At SEMICON West 2026, NVIDIA demonstrated a next-generation co-packaged optics technology called **OOI (Optics-on-Interposer)**, placing the optical engine directly onto the silicon interposer that carries the GPU. Per researcher Nikola Nedovic, the approach replaces the organic package substrate with a larger interposer.

OOI remains a research prototype with no commercial timeline, but it points to a new interconnect strategy for the next generation of hyperscale AI clusters.

zh.title: 英伟达在 SEMICON West 展示下一代共封装光学原型 OOI
zh.excerpt: OOI 将光引擎直接集成到承载 GPU 的硅中介层上，进一步贴近芯片内核。
zh.content:
在 SEMICON West 2026 上，英伟达展示了名为 **OOI（Optics-on-Interposer，中介层上集成光学）** 的下一代共封装光学技术，将光引擎直接集成到承载 GPU 的硅中介层之上。据英伟达研究院首席科学家 Nikola Nedovic 介绍，该方案以更大面积的中介层取代现行有机封装基板。

OOI 目前仍处研究阶段，暂无商业化时间表，但为下一代超大规模 AI 集群提供了全新的互联思路。

en.title: MIT's Collins Lab Reports 9 AI-Discovered Antibiotic Candidates
en.excerpt: Virtual screening across 70 billion molecules surfaces candidates against drug-resistant pathogens.
en.content:
As of Nov 2, MIT's Collins Lab **Antibiotics-AI Project** has used AI to virtually screen more than **70 billion molecules**, running antibacterial tests on over 38,000 and human-cell screens on over 100,000, yielding nine novel antibiotic candidates. Examples include NG1 against drug-resistant gonorrhea and DN1 against multidrug-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.

All candidates remain preclinical; the work shows AI shifting from searching existing libraries to designing molecules that did not previously exist, though rigorous safety and clinical validation still lie ahead.

zh.title: MIT 科林斯实验室用 AI 发现 9 种抗生素候选物
zh.excerpt: 对 700 亿个分子的虚拟筛选，产出针对耐药病原体的候选分子。
zh.content:
截至 11 月 2 日，MIT 科林斯实验室的「抗生素 AI 项目」已借助 AI 累计虚拟筛选超过 **700 亿个分子**，对逾 3.8 万个分子开展抗菌实验、对逾 10 万个分子进行人体细胞相关筛查，进而发现或设计出 **9 种新型抗生素候选物**。代表性成果包括针对耐药淋球菌的 NG1、针对多重耐药金黄色葡萄球菌的 DN1。

所有候选物仍处临床前阶段；该工作表明 AI 正从「在现有药物库中找答案」转向「直接设计此前不存在的分子」，但毒理、药代与临床试验等验证仍不可或缺。

en.title: Tsinghua Team Uses Explainable AI to Design Better mRNA Delivery Lipids
en.excerpt: A machine-learning screen of 10,920 lipid structures yielded a candidate 4x more effective in mice.
en.content:
A Tsinghua Shenzhen team led by Yan Hao and Kang Feiyu used **explainable AI** to screen degradable lipid candidates for mRNA delivery. They modularly combined 40 amine heads with 13 degradable tails to synthesize 520 lipids, then used an XGBoost model to extend the virtual search to **10,920 structures**.

One candidate, **PA97MD101**, delivered roughly 4x the liver mRNA expression of the common control lipid SM-102 in mice, and also delivered EPO mRNA and CRISPR/Cas9 payloads. The study, in Nature Communications, frames AI as a materials-selection assistant whose hits still require independent animal validation.

zh.title: 清华团队用可解释 AI 筛选更优 mRNA 递送脂质
zh.excerpt: 对 10920 种脂质结构的机器学习筛选，得到在小鼠中效力提升约 4 倍的新材料。
zh.content:
清华大学深圳国际研究生院颜昊、康飞宇团队借助**可解释人工智能（AI）**，从上万种可降解脂质候选中优选 mRNA 精准递送材料。他们将 40 种胺类头部与 13 种可降解尾部模块化组合，合成 520 种脂质，再用 XGBoost 模型将虚拟筛选空间拓展至 **10920 种结构**。

其中一种名为 **PA97MD101** 的脂质，在小鼠实验中带来的肝脏 mRNA 功能表达约为常用对照脂质 SM-102 的 4 倍，并可递送促红细胞生成素 mRNA 及 CRISPR/Cas9 相关载荷。该研究发表于《自然·通讯》，将 AI 定位为帮助科学家缩小搜索范围的「选材助手」，其命中结果仍需独立动物实验验证。

en.title: Google Ships Nano Banana 2 Lite and Opens Gemini Omni Flash to Developers
en.excerpt: A 4-second image model and a conversational video editor target high-throughput creative pipelines.
en.content:
Google released **Nano Banana 2 Lite**, its fastest and most cost-efficient image model, generating a 1K image in about 4 seconds at $0.034 per image, and opened **Gemini Omni Flash** to developers via the Gemini API and AI Studio. Omni Flash enables conversational video generation and editing from text, image and video inputs at $0.10 per second of output.

Both models carry SynthID watermarking and target high-volume, latency-sensitive creative workflows; Adobe and WPP are among the first partners integrating them into Firefly and WPP Open.

zh.title: 谷歌推出 Nano Banana 2 Lite 并向开发者开放 Gemini Omni Flash
zh.excerpt: 4 秒出图的图像模型与对话式视频编辑器，瞄准高吞吐创意管线。
zh.content:
谷歌发布**最快、最具性价比的图像模型 Nano Banana 2 Lite**，约 4 秒生成一张 1K 图像、单价 0.034 美元，并经由 Gemini API 与 AI Studio 向开发者开放 **Gemini Omni Flash**。Omni Flash 支持以文本、图像、视频多模态输入进行对话式视频生成与编辑，输出单价为每秒 0.10 美元。

两款模型均内置 SynthID 水印，面向高吞吐、低延迟的创意工作流；Adobe 与 WPP 是首批将其集成进 Firefly 与 WPP Open 的合作伙伴。
